title.narrative: Organización Nacional de Mujeres Indígenas Andinas y Amazónicas del Perú (ONAMIAP)

description.narrative: The National Organization of Andean and Amazonian Indigenous Women of Peru (ONAMIAP) is an organization that has been fighting since 2009 for the full exercise of their individual and collective rights as women and indigenous peoples. ONAMIAP is a strengthened organization with bases in 10 regions of Peru, which has recognition, leadership and social and political representation at the regional, national and international level. The grant will support the following priorities and specific activities:- Training school on individual and collective rights for young people- Youth meetings to define the minimum thematic axes that a proposal for a new constitution must contain.- Communicative Advocacy Plan for a new constitution that makes visible the demands of indigenous women in this process.
